messages:
sam: who let Snack-Bard loose in the kitchen at 2am? found a sonnet on my salad lol

sam: ```
Oh verdant leaf and vinaigrette bright,
Your crinkled bowl begs rescue from night.
Retrieve me soon, lest destiny conspire,
To make me lonely and slightly dryer.

Snack-Bard v2.0 (trained on late-night haikus)
```

rhea: it has more drama than my last breakup :sob:

otis: this is peak office culture. do we have an option for 'utility only' tone?

maya: also why did it rhyme "conspire" with "dryer" like it's trying to punish me for leaving it out

snack-bot: persona toggle set to 'playful-poet' by @rhea at 02:03AM. Available modes: `playful-poet`, `neutral-reminder`, `stern-ops`.

sam: change my salad to `neutral-reminder` please

snack-bot: confirmation: updated. new note for your salad -> "This item looks like it might be yours. Please collect within 48 hours."

rhea: contest idea: rewrite Snack-Bard notes in the voice of famous authors. Winner gets two free lunch credits.

otis: vote: 1) Shakespearean sandwich, 2) Hemingway hummus, 3) Dr. Seuss salad, 4) Noir leftovers

sam: Hemingway hummus so it just says 'Eat it. Now.'

maya: Dr. Seuss salad would be peak chaos tbh

culture: loving this. submitting $15 in lunch credits for the author-voice contest :tada: Please tag entries with #snackbar-poet

rhea: tiny ask: can we add a privacy note so bots don't say specific timestamps like 'left yesterday at 17:03' in the public note?

snack-bot: privacy preference saved: `no-specific-times` -> notes will use relative phrasing (e.g., 'within 48 hours').

otis: also adding beret emoji to Snack-Bard persona because obviously

sam: closing thread with official rules: 1) no judging other people's leftovers, 2) bots must be trained on consent, 3) lunch credits to winner

maya: rules accepted. starting my Shakespearean entry in 10m :scroll:
